final: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount - spent) AS overall_avg FROM budget), per_status AS (SELECT event_status AS status, AVG(amount - spent) AS average_left_over FROM budget GROUP BY event_status) SELECT per_status.status, per_status.average_left_over, per_status.average_left_over - overall.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall FROM per_status CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
